4973.about: A young traveller films himself in three places: first standing with arms thrown wide in front of a white marble domed mausoleum at the end of a long reflecting pool, then leaning grinning over cones of bright yellow, orange and red spice at a covered market stall, and finally in a street where people in white clothes hurl clouds of pink, yellow and green powder over each other, until his face and shirt are smeared with colour and he laughs into the lens.
4973.question: What is the young traveller doing?
4973.answer: He is posing in front of a monument.

4974.about: A street tea stall hung with orange marigold garlands: a vendor in an orange kurta lifts a steel pan high above his head and pours a long unbroken stream of milky tea down into a jug at waist height without spilling a drop, repeating the trick while a tight semicircle of young men film him, laugh and applaud; he then fills small steel cups and hands them round.

phrases.en: to pour tea from a height
to hand out cups of tea

4974.question: What is the seller doing?
4974.answer: He is pouring tea from a height.

4975.about: A tide of commuters in grey and navy suits with briefcases crosses a street between glass office towers; in the middle of them walks one young woman in a bright turquoise coat, red beret, yellow headphones and yellow boots, the only colour in the crowd. She perches on a concrete bollard while the suits stream past behind her, sips an orange juice and smiles into the camera.
4975.question: What is the woman in blue drinking?

4977.about: A first-person clip in the tropics: an outstretched arm and open hand with beaded bracelets fills the foreground, leading the camera along a path through misty green rice terraces while a smiling long-haired man holds on at the other end. He then sits on the steps of a carved stone temple beside a monkey, and finally rides a big rope swing out over a jungle valley of palms and terraces, feet bare against the sky.
4977.question: What is the man sitting next to?
4977.answer: He is sitting next to a monkey.

4978.about: A young street-food cook works a wok at a night market stall: a huge column of flame leaps from the pan as he tosses fried rice, he cracks an egg into the wok and stirs it with a ladle, flips the pan into another burst of fire, then plates the rice with a fried egg on top and satay skewers beside it and spreads his arms proudly behind the finished plate.
4978.question: What is the cook doing?
4978.answer: He is cooking rice in a pan.

4979.about: An open-plan office full of desks, monitors and desk phones: a man in a blue shirt coughs into his hand at his desk, a colleague standing behind him coughs too, a woman at another desk looks unwell while a colleague reaches over with a pen, and further down the room two more women blow their noses into tissues at their screens while everyone else keeps working.

phrases.target: the man in the dark jumper

4979.question: What are the office workers doing?

4980.about: On a hilltop above green fields under a clear blue sky a woman tilts her head back, closes her eyes and breathes in deeply; a man holds a mug of coffee under his nose and breathes in the steam; a woman with curly hair pushes her nose into a bunch of bright flowers; a man leans open-mouthed over a fresh loaf of bread; finally a group of friends stands in a circle with their arms spread wide, heads back, all taking a deep breath together.
4980.question: What are the friends doing?
4980.answer: They are taking a deep breath.

4981.about: In a bright clinic room a queue of young people wait their turn. A young man pulls his sleeve up and grins over his shoulder while a syringe goes into his upper arm, then shows the round plaster stuck on the spot; a young woman in a black top takes hers the same way and points at her plaster; a woman in glasses gets her injection next; at the end the whole group lines up facing the camera and taps the plasters on their bare arms.

phrases.target: the woman in the grey top

4981.question: What is the young man doing?
4981.answer: He is getting a vaccine in his upper arm.

4982.about: On a green football pitch a player in a white kit dribbles the ball, then suddenly pulls up, grimaces and doubles over. He drops onto the grass and grips his leg just above the boot, his face twisted in pain. Two opponents in blue crouch down, take him under the arms and lift him back onto his feet, and he ends up sitting on a wooden bench at the side of the pitch, still holding the same spot above his foot.
4982.question: What is the man in white holding?

4983.about: At a mountain border crossing a man in a light blue uniform with rank stars on his shoulders and white gloves opens a passport and studies the photo page. At a metal table he shines a small torch into an open suitcase and lifts out the folded clothes one by one. He then walks along the side of a camper van with a gloved hand on the bodywork, lies flat on the road to shine his torch underneath it, and slides back out beside a clipboard while a second man in the same uniform works behind him.
4983.question: What is the officer lying under?
4983.answer: He is lying under a van.

4984.about: On a seaside promenade lined with palm trees an older woman with a grey plait, knee pads and elbow pads rolls along on a skateboard, laughing. A jogger passes her, then a man in a dark coat hops onto a board behind her and copies her, and finally a man in a business suit carrying a black briefcase in one hand steps onto a skateboard as well. All of them roll down the promenade together past the benches and the sea, grinning.

phrases.en: to skate in a business suit

4984.question: What is the businessman carrying?
4984.answer: He is carrying a black briefcase.

4985.about: In an office two workers put up screens. A woman on a stepladder holds a cordless drill against a small bracket high on the wall while a man in a blue polo steadies it from below; he then reaches up to a round detector on the ceiling. The two of them carry a large flat screen over to the wall, lift it onto the bracket and press it firmly into place, then step back and look at it. At the end a whole wall of nine screens is up and switched on.

phrases.en: to reach up to the ceiling

4985.question: What are the two workers doing?
4985.answer: They are fixing the screen to the wall.

4986.about: A woman in a white shirt aims a cordless drill at a wall while a man in a blue polo holds a spirit level against a black bracket and then reaches up towards the ceiling. The two of them carry a large black screen across the room, hang it on the wall and switch it on, and it lights up in strong blue. In the last shot the room is dark and a wall of nine mounted screens glows bright blue, lighting up both of their faces and the plastic sheet spread over the floor.
4986.question: What colour are the screens?

4987.about: In a glass-walled meeting room high above the city a woman in a black suit stands at a whiteboard covered in coloured sticky notes and talks her colleagues through her work while they sit around a table full of laptops. One after another they cut in: a man raises a finger, others lean forward and talk over her, and she raises her voice to keep going. Then a young man walks in behind her with a tray of takeaway coffees, the whole table turns to the coffee, and she leans on the table looking defeated.

phrases.target: the woman in the black suit

phrases.en: to carry a tray of coffees
phrases.target: the man in the dark shirt
the woman in the black suit

4987.question: What is the man carrying?
4987.answer: He is carrying a tray of takeaway coffees.

4988.about: A crowd of medieval re-enactors in helmets and tunics pours down a long grassy field toward a camp of white canvas tents. A man in full plate armour runs at the front holding a tall blue banner, and hundreds of fighters with shields and spears follow him downhill while spectators watch from behind ropes at the top of the field.
4988.question: What is the man in armour carrying?
4988.answer: He is carrying a big flag.

4989.about: Filmed from behind a rope barrier at the foot of a grassy ridge. First one armoured fighter with a red banner appears on the crest, then a long line of re-enactors with coloured flags comes over the top and charges down the slope toward the camera, passing a white canvas tent. Spectators in the foreground film it on their phones.

phrases.en: to run ahead of the others

4989.question: Where are the men running?
4989.answer: They are running down the hill.

4990.about: A young man in a grey sleeveless top works alone in a launderette in front of a row of big industrial washing machines. He shakes out a striped shirt, lays it flat on an ironing board and presses it with a heavy steam iron, then reaches for the next item beside a tall stack of folded, freshly washed clothes.

phrases.en: to put clothes on a pile

4990.question: What is the man doing?

4991.about: A man in a colourful tie-dye shirt and glasses stands over a bed heaped with a big pile of crumpled clothes. He pulls a badly creased blue shirt out of the heap and pulls a face at the state of it, then irons it flat on a board and finally holds it up, smooth, beside a rail of hanging shirts.

phrases.en: to glide over a creased shirt
to hold up a smooth shirt

4991.question: What is the man ironing?
4991.answer: He is ironing a creased blue shirt.

4992.about: An older woman in a yellow cardigan carries a big armful of clean laundry across a bright room, opens a tall white cupboard and pulls out a folding ironing board. She sets it up on the wooden floor, spreads its patchwork cover flat, then works through the pile with a steam iron and holds up a finished pale blue shirt.

phrases.en: to carry a lot of clothes
to hold up a blue shirt

4992.question: What is the woman carrying?
4992.answer: She is carrying a lot of clothes.

4993.about: A woman in a chunky cream jumper paddles a red canoe straight toward the camera across a huge, glassy blue lake. The drone pulls back and up and she is the only person on the water. She reaches a tiny rock island with a single pine tree on it, steps out and stands there by herself, the whole scene mirrored in the still water.

phrases.en: to stand next to a tree

4993.question: Where is the woman standing?
4993.answer: She is standing next to a tree.

4994.about: An elderly woman in a flowery apron winds a sheet of pasta dough through a hand-cranked pasta machine in a rustic kitchen, with cut strips drying on a rack below. She then stirs a big red pot of meat and tomato sauce with a long wooden spoon, blows on it and tastes it, drops in a basil leaf, and finally carries the finished dish out to a long wooden table where a whole family claps and cheers.
4994.question: What is the woman carrying?
4994.answer: She is carrying a big plate of pasta.

4997.about: A selfie travel clip in three beats. First a young man with a camera round his neck holds the phone at arm's length in front of the Leaning Tower of Pisa and throws his head back with a loud open-mouthed laugh. Then he leans over the side of a gondola in a narrow Venice canal, laughing again and trailing his hand towards the green water under a small bridge with washing strung between the houses. Finally, in front of the Colosseum at sunset, a vendor hands him a huge ice cream stacked several scoops high and he laughs in disbelief as he holds it up.

phrases.en: to lean out of a gondola

4997.question: What is the man holding?
4997.answer: He is holding a giant ice cream cone.

4998.about: A selfie travel clip in three beats. A young man in a yellow jacket with a camera round his neck holds the phone out on a crowded city crossing at dusk, with lit screens and pedestrians behind him. Then the camera moves forward down a long shaded passage formed by hundreds of orange shrine gates standing one behind the other, with a bright opening far ahead at the end. Finally he sits at a lit night stall under red paper lanterns and eats a bowl of ramen with chopsticks.
4998.question: What is the man eating?
4998.answer: He is eating ramen with chopsticks.

5000.about: A sushi counter clip. A young chef in a white jacket and a white headband leans over a wooden block and cuts thin flat slices off a long orange fillet of raw fish with a narrow knife. He then presses a handful of rice into shape in his palm and lays the orange slice over it, torches the finished pieces with a small blowtorch, sets a piece down on a grey plate in front of the camera and grins.
5000.question: What is the man cutting?
5000.answer: He is cutting thin slices of fish.

5001.about: A woman in a striped headscarf rides a train and looks out of the window at a river and dry hills sliding past. She then rides in a crowded minibus with bundles of luggage strapped overhead. Finally she hikes up a stony mountain path with a canvas backpack and a walking stick and stops on the ridge, where the whole valley opens out below her: a blue-painted village spread over the slope and bare brown mountains running to the horizon.
5001.question: What is the woman doing?
5001.answer: She is looking at the landscape.

5002.about: A calm forest lake in fading evening light, the sun already gone behind the pine treeline and the sky still warm orange. A man in green shorts leaps off the end of a wooden jetty and lands in the water with a ring of spray. More people then run down the jetty and throw themselves in one after another, each raising a burst of white splash, until several heads are bobbing in the dark water while the last daylight drains out of the sky.
5002.question: What are the people doing?
5002.answer: They are leaping off the jetty at dusk.

5005.about: A young woman in a navy polo shirt sits in a coastal watch station with nautical charts pinned to the wall and a brass bell beside the window. She scans the water through binoculars. Through the glass the sea curves inland between two green headlands, sheltered water dotted with moored yachts, small boats and orange buoys, with the open sea beyond. An orange rescue boat powers out across the water leaving a long white wake, and she lowers the binoculars and points at it.
5005.question: What is the woman pointing at?
5005.answer: She is pointing at the orange boat.

5006.about: An older woman in a patchwork apron fills a stainless steel electric kettle from the kitchen tap, then sets it back on its round base on the worktop, where a red light comes on and it starts to boil. She carries it to a wooden table where five brightly patterned mugs stand in a row, each with a teabag in it, and pours the boiling water into one mug after another.
5006.question: What is the woman doing?
5006.answer: She is pouring water into mugs.

5008.about: A woman in denim dungarees with a lanyard round her neck opens a brass letterbox set into a stone wall and takes a key out of it. She turns the key in the brass plate of a tall black door, then holds up a huge ring of old keys and picks through them. She fits another key into an ornate wooden door with a heavy iron handle, turns it, and pushes the double doors open onto a sunlit garden path with ivy-covered walls.
5008.question: What is the woman doing?
5008.answer: She is unlocking a brass letterbox.

5009.about: A red-haired boy grins as he slides down a blue playground slide on a sunny day. He then runs across the grass of a park lawn and kicks a black-and-white football, and walks back with the climbing frame behind him. The camera pans over an empty park path and ends on the playground with the ball lying on the lawn.
5009.question: What is the boy kicking?

5010.about: In a stone hall lined with guards in bearskin hats, a man in a red velvet robe walks up a red carpet to a golden throne. He sits down and a gold crown is placed on his head, then he strides back through the hall smiling. He steps onto a castle balcony above a huge crowd and raises his arms while the crowd cheers below the towers and flags.

phrases.en: to walk on a red carpet

5010.question: Where is the king sitting?
5010.answer: He is sitting on a throne.

5011.about: On a Paris cafe terrace two women in coats hug at a table set with coffee cups. Then an elderly grey-haired couple sits on a green bench by the street; the man cups the woman's cheek and they kiss for a long moment. Finally a young couple kisses in front of the Eiffel Tower, the man dipping the woman backwards while guests at the cafe tables clap.

phrases.target: the woman in the red hat

5011.question: What is the old man doing?
5011.answer: He is kissing an old woman.

5013.about: Three kitchens are compared with a price caption over each one. First a frail old man stirs a pot on a single gas burner in a shabby room with peeling walls, captioned 500 euro. Then a woman in a bright white family kitchen pulls a tray of cookies out of the oven, captioned 10,000 euro. Last a man stands at the marble island of a glass-walled penthouse kitchen with the city skyline behind him, captioned 100,000 euro.
5013.question: What is the woman doing?
5013.answer: She is taking cookies out of the oven.

5014.about: Three cooks in three very different kitchens. An old man in a vest tastes soup from a wooden spoon over a battered pot on a gas ring in a tiled, run-down room, then cracks an egg into it. A woman in a bright white kitchen lifts a baked cheesy dish out of the oven with oven gloves. Finally a man in a black turtleneck tosses peppers in a frying pan in a penthouse kitchen with copper pans hanging overhead and the night skyline in the windows, then spreads his arms wide.
5014.question: What is the woman holding?
5014.answer: She is holding a hot dish.

5015.about: In a rustic kitchen with painted pottery on wooden shelves, a young woman in an apron and an older woman in a headscarf stand at a floured wooden table. They push and fold a large pale mass of bread dough with their hands, laughing together, until it is shaped into a smooth round loaf on the flour-dusted table.
5015.question: What are the two women doing?
5015.answer: They are kneading the dough together.

5016.about: A young man in a white T-shirt and denim shorts sits barefoot on a clinic examination couch while a doctor in a white coat stands beside him holding a reflex hammer. He stands up, bends his legs and drops into a deep squat facing the camera so his bare knees are in the middle of the frame, then sits back on the couch, puts a hand on his knee and laughs with the doctor.
5016.question: What is the doctor holding?
5016.answer: She is holding a small hammer.

5017.about: Close up, a man's hands slice a tomato into thin rounds with a large kitchen knife on a wooden board. He works along the board slicing cucumber, then yellow pepper, then a red onion, until the board is covered with neat rows of pieces. He straightens up behind the board, which now shows the vegetables laid out in a rainbow-coloured row, and speaks to the camera.
5017.question: What is the man doing?
5017.answer: He is cutting vegetables with a knife.

5019.about: In a busy Korean barbecue restaurant a young woman in a white shirt and black apron stands at a round table grill; thick red marbled slices of beef sit on the mesh over a tall flame, ringed by dozens of small dishes of kimchi, greens and sauces. She turns and moves the slices with tongs until they brown, then lays a piece on a lettuce leaf, folds it into a parcel and holds it out to the camera while the guests behind her clap and laugh.

phrases.en: to cook beef on a grill

5019.question: What is the waitress doing?
5019.answer: She is cooking beef on a grill.

5020.about: In a bright flat a young woman points up at a ceiling fitting whose bare bulb is dead. She and a young man carry in an aluminium stepladder and open it under the fitting; she climbs the steps while he steadies the frame, screws a new bulb into the socket and it lights up warm and bright. They look up at the working light, then fold the ladder away.
5020.question: What is the woman doing?
5020.answer: She is replacing a light bulb.

5021.about: An outdoor tea party on a lawn in front of parkland. A young woman in a long pale floral Regency dress and a straw bonnet, her hair in ringlets, stands at a laid table, then sits and pours tea from a white porcelain teapot into painted cups. She passes a plate of scones with jam across the table to a man in a jacket who wipes his hands on a linen napkin, and at the end she raises her teacup with the others and smiles into the camera.

phrases.target: the lady in the straw hat
the lady in the straw hat

5021.question: What is the lady doing?
5021.answer: She is pouring tea into a cup.

5022.about: Three lit interiors in a row. First a dark study at night where a bent desk lamp throws a warm pool of light over stacked books, folders and a laptop while someone works at the desk. Then a colourful living room where a woman reaches to a tall floor lamp with a wide drum shade and it comes on, filling the room with warm light. Last a grand marble hall where a woman in a long silver gown stands under an enormous crystal chandelier that blazes above her and casts sparkling reflections on the polished floor.
5022.question: What is the man doing?
5022.answer: He is sitting at a desk.

5023.about: A young man with bleached hair in a blue rain jacket stands at a wire fence beside an airfield under a clear sky, filming himself with a gull perched on a fence post in front of him. A small white propeller plane comes down and touches its wheels on the runway behind him. Then a huge four-engine airliner drops in very low right over his head, wheels out, and lands on the runway; he turns to watch it, throws both fists in the air and shouts in delight.
5023.question: What is flying over the man?
5023.answer: A big airplane is flying over him.

5024.about: In a fairy-lit cafe a curly-haired woman sits at a table with small national flags and thick decorated dictionaries, greets the camera brightly, then jumps up and runs across the room. She sits down opposite a woman in a kimono who bows with pressed palms over an open book, then stands holding a huge stack of dictionaries, each spine carrying a different language. At the end the whole cafe raises coffee cups around her and her tower of books.
5024.question: What is the curly-haired woman carrying?

5025.about: In a university lecture room a student with bright blue hair looks at something on his phone and starts laughing. The classmates around him crack up too, one throwing his head back, until the whole room is roaring. Then a teacher walks in and stands at the whiteboard, the class sits back down at their laptops, and one boy is left lying on the floor between the desks still shaking.
5025.question: What is the teacher doing?
5025.answer: He is standing at the whiteboard.

5026.about: A student with blue hair in a yellow hoodie sits in a lecture hall staring at his phone and laughing so hard that he covers his mouth and wipes tears out of his eyes. A girl with braids leans over to look at the screen and laughs with him, and a classmate behind them roars with his mouth wide open while the rest of the room carries on working.
5026.question: What is the blue-haired student doing?

5028.about: In a wood-panelled courtroom a man in a grey suit heaves armfuls of heavy leather-bound volumes onto the bench beside a set of brass scales and a gavel, and the pile keeps growing. A close shot shows one thick book lying open on the stack, its pages dense with tiny print, with rows of seated people behind it. In the last shot the stack has become a tower taller than the people, the judge sits beside it and the whole room stands staring.

phrases.en: to lie open on the pile

5028.question: What is the young man carrying?

5030.about: A street carnival in a city of tall shuttered houses hung with bunting. A woman in a rainbow feather costume walks down the middle of the road carrying a tall banner on a pole, smiling straight ahead, with a large crowd of people walking close behind her. Drummers in matching yellow and blue tops move along the road in rows with drums strapped to them, and the balconies on both sides are packed with people watching.

phrases.target: the woman in the feather costume

5030.question: What is the woman in feathers doing?
5030.answer: She is carrying a banner down the street.

5032.about: On an alpine trail below snowy peaks a woman in a red jacket holds an open map, raises her arm and points along the path, and a line of hikers with poles and backpacks walks behind her. She steps first across a stream on stones while the group waits on the bank and watches her line. Then a women's rowing four cuts across a turquoise lake, the woman in the bow setting the stroke and finally punching a fist into the air.

phrases.target: the woman at the front of the boat

5032.question: What is the woman in red doing?

5033.about: A carnival parade fills a wide street hung with rainbow bunting between balconies packed with spectators. A woman in a huge rainbow feather headdress and a silver bodysuit walks down the centre line of the road at the front with her arms flung wide. Behind her, rows of drummers in white outfits and rainbow-striped trousers carry big rainbow-painted drums strapped at the waist and beat them with sticks as they advance, with a dense crowd stretching back down the street.
5033.question: What is the woman doing?
5033.answer: She is dancing in the street.

5034.about: A woman in a grey bathrobe holds up a white milk carton that is split at the seam; milk runs out of it and pools in a white puddle on the wooden table while she stares at it in dismay. She then crouches under a kitchen sink where water drips out of the plastic trap into a grey bucket. Finally she stands in a large stucco room where drips fall from the ceiling into a dozen coloured plastic bowls hung from strings, and she reaches up to steady one.
5034.question: What is dripping into the bucket?
5034.answer: Water is dripping from the pipe.

5035.about: In a sunny park a young person in a rainbow tie-dye tracksuit bends down and picks up three pastel balls from the grass, then straightens up and juggles them in a smooth cascade. Three friends sit on the lawn behind and watch, smiling. The juggler grins wide as the balls arc above their head.
5035.question: What is the blond girl doing?

5036.about: In a courtyard between brightly painted apartment blocks a young man in a rust hoodie tries to juggle two balls, fumbles and grabs his head in embarrassment while a young woman in a denim jacket beside him holds more balls and shows him how. He tries again, tossing one ball up and catching it, gets a little further each time, and at the end both of them laugh and she claps.
5036.question: What is the man doing?

5037.about: A woman in a camel trench coat wheels a grey suitcase across a marble hotel lobby and out through a revolving glass door. She steps onto the wide paved sidewalk of a Paris street, cars passing on the road right beside her, and looks around while other people walk past her on the same pavement. She then comes back in and stops at the reception counter with a document in her hand.
5037.question: Where is the woman in the coat?
5037.answer: She is standing on the sidewalk.

5038.about: A woman in teal running kit and a pink cap props one leg on a wooden railing on the Great Wall and stretches at sunrise. She then sets off up the long stone staircase, running at a steady even rhythm, breathing hard, with the watchtower and hills behind her and a few walkers far below.
5038.question: What is the runner doing?
5038.answer: She is running at a steady pace.

5039.about: At sunrise on a city rooftop an old man with a white beard stands in front of a tall stack of wooden and wire bird cages with small birds inside, and unlatches the little doors one after another. Birds burst out of the cages and the sky fills with a huge flock. He holds an empty cage in his arms and looks up, and the crowd of people behind him watches the birds circle over the city.

phrases.en: to have a bushy white beard

5039.question: What is the old man holding?
5039.answer: He is holding an empty cage.

5040.about: At a flea market on a cobbled Flemish square a woman in a rust jacket holds up a big brass table lamp, then squats down and heaves a wooden crate full of vinyl records up onto a cargo bike. Next she and another person lift a large mustard-yellow velvet armchair with padded arm supports onto the same bike, on top of the crate, and she claps and laughs at the loaded bike.
5040.question: What are the two women lifting?
5040.answer: They are lifting a velvet armchair.

5042.about: Gym-goers come out of a glass gym door in sportswear, walking stiff-legged and grimacing. A man in a grey T-shirt holds the door and winces as he steps down, and a blonde woman in leggings hobbles out after him. A woman with curly hair lowers herself onto a street bench with her face screwed up, then sits rubbing her legs. At the end the whole group waddles down the pavement together with straight, sore legs.

phrases.target: the man in the grey T-shirt

phrases.en: to wear a navy crop top

5042.question: What is the curly-haired woman doing?
5042.answer: She is lowering herself onto a bench.

5044.about: A montage of people taking in sounds. A young man in a sunlit room wears big over-ear headphones, eyes closed and smiling as music plays. Two women sit over coffee in a cafe, one talking with her hand at her temple while the other leans in towards her. A man in a blue shirt presses the side of his face and a cupped hand against a closed office door in a corridor, eyes wide. Finally a festival crowd stands in front of a lit stage at dusk, some of them pressing their hands over their ears.

phrases.target: the man in the blue shirt

5044.question: What is the man with headphones doing?

5045.about: At night on a neon-lit Korean shopping street, a young man with bleached hair and headphones around his neck cups a hand behind his ear towards the camera, then pulls the headphones up over his ears. The camera swings down to the pavement, where a big silver boombox with two round speakers stands next to a lamppost, playing while shoppers pass behind it. The clip ends at a concert in front of a towering wall of stacked loudspeakers, with a performer on stage and the crowd's hands in the air.
5045.question: What is the young man wearing?

5047.about: An evening in a family living room. A young man sits on a grey corner sofa with a remote control in his hand, laughing at the television, while other people move around in the kitchen behind him. A red-haired woman runs in and flops down beside him, and a young man in a blue T-shirt sits down with a big bowl of popcorn. A woman brings a thick blue blanket over and spreads it across all four of them, and they settle in shoulder to shoulder under it, eating popcorn and watching the screen. A wall clock, a lamp, a picture and the kitchen are visible behind the sofa.

phrases.target: the man in the blue T-shirt

5047.question: What are they eating?

5048.about: An elderly woman in a colourful headscarf works at a pair of tall black wooden doors studded with iron and hung with two heavy ring handles. A thick chain is threaded through the rings and closed with a big iron padlock, and she turns a key in it with both hands, a huge bunch of keys hanging at her belt. In between there is a shot of her standing on a wall above the old town holding a whole watermelon over a wooden crate, with a church tower and tiled roofs behind her. She goes back to the doors and works the padlock again, and the doors stay firmly shut the whole time.
5048.question: What is the old woman doing?
5048.answer: She is fiddling with a huge padlock.

5049.about: A montage of things being shut and locked up. Hands hook a brass padlock through the metal hasp of a wooden garden gate and snap it closed. A man in a cream jacket crouches by a bike rack in a town square and threads a lock through his bicycle frame, then spins the dial of a combination padlock on a rainbow cable wrapped around the rack. In the last shots he turns a key in the lock of a wooden front door under a porch light at dusk, pulls the door closed behind him and walks away.
5049.question: What is the man doing?

5050.about: An election night party in a small hall decorated with balloons, banners and a table of drinks and pastries. A grey-haired man in a suit with a blue-and-white rosette holds a microphone in front of a screen showing a bar chart of the results, and his face collapses as he reads it. The guests get up and walk out, leaving rows of empty chairs and confetti on the floor. He sits alone on a bench under the screen staring ahead, then drops his head into both hands.
5050.question: What is the grey-haired man doing?
5050.answer: He is burying his face in his hands.

5051.about: A young woman in a hostel dorm with metal bunk beds tips a khaki backpack out onto the floor and rakes through the growing heap of clothes. She stands over the mess with her hands on her hips, mouth open in dismay, then kneels and searches under the bunk, shakes the empty backpack, and finally sits down on the bed holding her head, because whatever she is looking for is not there.
5051.question: What is the young woman doing?
5051.answer: She is rummaging through her clothes.

5054.about: Outdoors on a sunny day, a big man in a bright floral shirt swings a heavy duffel bag onto his shoulder, then leans hard into a luggage trolley loaded with three suitcases and a cool box and shoves it along the road. At a silver van he heaves case after case into the boot until it is crammed full, shuts it, and turns to the camera grinning and out of breath.

phrases.en: to load suitcases into a van

5054.question: What is the man lifting?
5054.answer: He is lifting suitcases into the boot.

5056.about: A hotel housekeeper in a turquoise uniform with a pink-trimmed apron snaps a white sheet out over a bed and lets it settle, plumps and squares up the pillows, then folds two towels into a swan and tucks a pink frangipani flower against its neck. She steps back smiling, then goes back to her trolley of stacked towels and toiletries in the doorway.

phrases.en: to shake out a bed sheet

5056.question: What is the maid folding?
5056.answer: She is folding the towels into swans.

5058.about: A teenage boy in a navy hoodie walks up to a black roadside mailbox, pulls the flap down and finds it empty, pulls a face and walks off. A postman in a blue postal uniform and cap, with a mail bag over his shoulder, comes along the street and pushes a bundle of letters into the same box. The boy comes running back delighted, opens it again and hauls out a thick stack of envelopes and a brown parcel.
5058.question: What is the postman doing?
5058.answer: He is putting letters in the mailbox.

5059.about: A young man in a navy hoodie stands at a black roadside mailbox with its red flag up and pulls the front hatch open; the box is empty. A postal worker in a blue jacket and cap arrives and pushes a thick block of white envelopes and a brown parcel into the box, filling it completely. The man reaches back in, drags out the enormous stack of letters and holds it against his chest, mouth open in delight.
5059.question: What is the man holding?
5059.answer: He is holding a lot of letters.

5060.about: A short montage of people of one sex at every age, all in a sunny park. A baby boy sits in a pushchair reaching for a coloured stacking toy held out to him; a boy rides a green kick scooter along a paved path past a colonnaded museum; a young man in a black vest does pull-ups on an outdoor bar; the same man flexes both arms and smiles at the camera; finally a father in a blue polo carries his little son on his shoulders while a grey-haired grandfather on a bench waves at the camera, all three waving.

phrases.en: to reach for a stacking toy
to do pull-ups on a bar

5060.question: What is the man in blue doing?
5060.answer: He is carrying a toddler on his shoulders.

5061.about: A young man in a white thobe rides an escalator up through a vast, bright shopping centre, looking around and laughing. He steps off into a huge circular atrium with balconies on many floors and glass capsule lifts running up the middle. He then walks to a railing in front of an enormous glass fish tank: sharks and rays glide through blue water above a stone tunnel, with an ice rink and skaters below. He spreads both arms wide and stares up at the sharks, open-mouthed.
5061.question: What is the young man looking at?
5061.answer: He is staring up at the sharks.

5063.about: A military band in black ceremonial uniforms with red-striped trousers and peaked caps moves down a city street in formation, legs swinging up high in unison and white-gloved arms swinging, brass instruments raised. An officer with a sword strides at the front. Behind steel barriers a dense crowd films and waves Indian flags. The shot then cuts to a wide view down a flag-lined avenue where a huge column of uniformed ranks stretches into the distance, watched by a grandfather holding a child in the foreground.
5063.question: What is the band doing?
5063.answer: The band is marching down the street.

5064.about: Close on a row of bandsmen in dark uniforms and white plumed helmets, each holding a golden brass instrument to his lips and blowing, fingers on the valves and the wide bells pointing forward. They play while walking in step down a street. The camera pulls back to show dozens more players in the same uniform filling the road, and behind the barriers a packed crowd waves Indian flags. The last shot looks down a long flag-lined avenue where the whole band stretches away in ranks.
5064.question: What are the bandsmen doing?
5064.answer: They are marching down a long avenue.

5065.about: A young man films himself walking through a busy Turkish street market. He holds an orange up to the camera and grins, then passes a fishmonger working beside large hanging scale pans over trays of iced fish. He walks on past barrels of green olives carrying a mesh bag of oranges, and finally walks down the long vaulted aisle of a covered spice bazaar, with rows of stalls piled high with coloured spices on both sides of him.
5065.question: Where is the young man walking?
5065.answer: He is strolling down a long aisle.

5066.about: A young man stands at an outdoor fruit stand in front of a mosque and picks up an orange while the vendor in an apron stacks more oranges behind him. He moves on to an olive stall and takes one single olive from a big metal tray to taste it, chewing and reacting to the flavour. He then walks through a covered spice bazaar past rows of coloured spice mounds and holds up his mesh bag of oranges to the camera.
5066.question: What is the young man eating?
5066.answer: He is eating a green olive.

5068.about: A wedding ceremony on a beach under a white rose arch, with the sea and cliffs behind. The bride, in a long white dress and a veil, slides a ring onto the groom's finger while he smiles down at her. He then takes her face in his hands and they kiss; the seated guests stand and applaud, and the two hold hands and laugh together under the arch.
5068.question: What are the bride and groom doing?
5068.answer: They are kissing on the beach.

5070.about: In a bright mattress showroom with rows of beds along a window wall, a young woman in colourful sportswear sits on the edge of a bare mattress and pulls a pained face, then lies back on it laughing. She stands up and talks to the camera, and finally throws herself backwards onto a large mattress, arms and legs spread wide, staring up at the ceiling.
5070.question: Where is the woman lying?
5070.answer: She is lying across a huge mattress.

5071.about: A bearded mechanic in blue overalls lies on a creeper and slides out from under a silver car in a busy repair shop. He then works in the open engine bay with a ratchet, loosens the wheel nuts with a red impact driver, tightens them with a long torque wrench, and finally straightens up, wipes his hands on a rag and closes the bonnet with a satisfied look.
5071.question: What is the mechanic doing?

5073.about: A young woman in a grey hoodie sits at a kitchen table with a box of tablets, an open pill case, a glass of water and a brown medicine bottle in front of her. She pours the brown syrup onto a spoon, swallows it, screws up her face in disgust and sticks out her tongue, gulps down the water, shudders, and finally screws the cap back on the bottle.
5073.question: What is the woman doing?

5074.about: A woman in an orange blazer walks into a bright open-plan office on her first day, carrying a cardboard box of desk things. One colleague after another steps up to shake her hand while she balances the box on one arm, and at the end the whole team stands around her, smiling and applauding as she shakes yet another hand.

phrases.target: the woman in the orange jacket
the woman in the orange jacket

5074.question: What is the woman in orange carrying?
5074.answer: She is carrying a big box.

5075.about: A man stands in a sunny Italian square holding a tall pink and white soft-serve ice cream. In the heat it melts faster than he can eat it: pink streams run down the cone, over his fingers and along his forearms, coating his hands. He licks at it desperately, then the whole scoop slides off the cone and splatters on the cobblestones, leaving him with sticky hands and an empty cone.

phrases.en: to be full of ice cubes

5075.question: What are the man's hands like?

5076.about: A young man with a backpack holds his card against the reader at a gym turnstile; a green tick lights up and he walks through into the gym. The clip cuts to a library chess club, where a smiling elderly woman arrives at a table of chess boards, sits down, and the other players wave, make a move on the board and applaud her as one of them.
5076.question: What is the old woman doing?
5076.answer: She is moving a chess piece.

5077.about: A student with silver-grey hair, glasses and headphones round his neck sits at a table in a busy study hall covered in small paper cards. He presses one card against his forehead with his eyes closed while he tries to say the answer, then looks at it to check, and works through card after card until the pile in front of him has grown into a heap. At the end he throws his fist up and grins, having got them all.
5077.question: What is the student doing?
5077.answer: He is trying to recall the answers.

5078.about: At a night-time street food stand a cook in a checked shirt and white apron shaves slices of roasted pork off a tall vertical spit topped with a pineapple, letting them fall onto the hot griddle. He warms a tortilla on the plate, piles the shredded pork onto it with red salsa, showers it with chopped onion and coriander, and then holds out a plate of three finished tacos to the customer with his arms spread wide.
5078.question: What is the cook doing?
5078.answer: He is carving slices of roast pork.

5079.about: A young woman with a straw tote bag walks away from the camera down a cobbled Mexican street strung overhead with rows of coloured paper banners. She then stands at a fruit market stall hung with bananas and stacked with oranges and limes and takes a large bite of a taco, pulling a delighted face. She climbs a wide flight of worn stone steps on an ancient ruin, and at the top she turns to the camera and throws both arms wide, with a huge stone pyramid rising out of green jungle behind her.
5079.question: What is the woman doing?
5079.answer: She is biting into a juicy taco.

5080.about: A young woman in a bright yellow sundress stands in a small clothes boutique in front of a tall wooden-framed mirror and looks at her reflection. She takes a mirror selfie with her phone in front of racks of clothes, then leans towards a vanity mirror ringed with bulbs and checks her face, then spins so the yellow skirt flares out between two mirrors. In the last shot she stands in a room lined with mirrors on the walls and floor, so the yellow dress is repeated in every direction.
5080.question: What is the woman wearing?
5080.answer: She is wearing a yellow dress.

5081.about: A young man in a blue hoodie stands in a hallway and inspects a silver ring through a small jeweller's magnifier, frowning at it. A blonde woman in a grey t-shirt tucks her hair behind her ear in front of a round black-framed bathroom mirror. A dark-haired woman in a fitted purple dress then walks through a dining room under a chandelier, stops at a tall gold-framed mirror and turns side-on to check how the purple dress fits, and finally looks over her shoulder at the back of it and laughs.
5081.question: What is the woman in purple doing?
5081.answer: She is looking in the mirror.

5082.about: A young woman in a coral top and a chunky yellow bead necklace dabs powder onto her cheek from a compact in a bright hallway, her hair piled up in a high bun. She leans towards a round gold-framed mirror on the wall, smooths her hair back with one hand and talks to her reflection, then adjusts the necklace at her throat. She turns to a large vanity mirror ringed with light bulbs, and in the last shot her hair has been arranged into two big rounded buns, which she shows off to the camera beside her reflection.
5082.question: What is the woman doing?
5082.answer: She is looking in the mirror.

5083.about: Two young women bake together at a floury kitchen counter. The blonde one in denim dungarees whisks yellow egg in a small white bowl while the other, in a green hoodie, steadies a big cream mixing bowl of pale batter. They tip a heap of small red berries into the batter, then each take a wooden spoon and stir hard together. The mixture thickens and turns brown, and both of them laugh and pull faces at how heavy it has become.

phrases.en: to whisk eggs in a bowl
to pour in the beaten eggs
to lick batter off her finger

5083.question: What are the two women doing?
5083.answer: They are stirring the batter together.

5084.about: At a fashion show, a model with a shaved head and large gold hoop earrings walks straight towards the camera down the runway in a floor-length, loose, shiny green gown with wide draped sleeves. Photographers and seated guests along both sides hold up phones to film her. She comes close enough for the green fabric to fill the frame and looks into the lens, then turns and walks away so the back of the gown swings behind her.

phrases.en: to wear a long green dress

5084.question: What is the woman wearing?
5084.answer: She is wearing a long green dress.

5085.about: A young woman in an embroidered white blouse and jeans tours several public memorials. She crouches beside a seated bronze figure of a bearded man on a stone plinth and points at the inscribed plaque, then stands up and takes a selfie with it while a pigeon flies past. She then stands in front of a tall stone column topped by a winged bronze figure, filming it with her phone, and finally walks across a wide plaza below a huge metal figure with outstretched arms, throwing her own arms up in the same pose.
5085.question: What is the woman pointing at?
5085.answer: She is pointing at the sign.

5086.about: In a high-rise office a woman in a dark uniform, yellow rubber gloves and yellow shoes pushes a flat mop across a wide stone floor. The floor she has already done throws back a clear mirror image of the ceiling lights and the windows. Behind a glass wall a meeting is going on at a long table with people in suits, none of whom look up. She works her way backwards across the hall, leaving one long polished strip after another.
5086.question: What is the cleaner doing?
5086.answer: She is mopping the shiny office floor.

5087.about: A white tiled kitchen floor is covered with a long line of muddy brown animal paw prints leading from the door across the room. An older man in a flat cap and braces dips a string mop into a grey bucket of water, wrings it out, and then pushes a flat mop over the prints. The tiles he has passed over come up white and clean again, until he stands at the far end of a spotless floor that reflects the window.
5087.question: What is the man doing?
5087.answer: He is cleaning the dirty floor.

5089.about: A red-haired woman in an apron is shown through a day with her children. She lifts a laughing toddler in a pink shirt up into the air in the living room, then flips pancakes at the stove while two small girls reach up for them, then kneels on the carpet and holds a girl's leg to look at a grazed knee. At the end she hugs the children goodbye on the pavement outside a school, among other parents and children with backpacks.

phrases.en: to go up in the air

5089.question: What is the mother making?

5091.about: A young man in a black leather jacket and jeans rides a small green two-wheeler through a sunny town, sitting up at the handlebars with the round headlight in front of him. He then stands astride a big black machine at a lookout above the sea. In the last part the camera rides with a whole group of riders in helmets and leather jackets as they roll down a coastal road above blue water.

phrases.target: the rider in the red helmet

5091.question: What is the man riding?

5092.about: A young woman in a grey t-shirt and black work gloves carries a large cardboard box down a driveway towards an open removal truck on a sunny suburban street. She walks back up the ramp, and two other people join her: one man inside the truck and one on the ground help her push a brown leather sofa in beside the stacked boxes. She then lifts another box up into the truck and finally turns to the camera, grinning and out of breath.
5092.question: What is the woman carrying?
5092.answer: She is carrying a big box.

5093.about: A man in a jumper and jeans pushes a red petrol lawn mower straight towards the camera through a back garden where the grass has grown long, pale and gone to seed. Each pass cuts a clean green strip out of the shaggy grass, and the shots alternate between behind the mower and in front of it. By the end a wide band of short green lawn runs down the middle of the garden with the tall unmown grass still standing on either side.
5093.question: What is the man doing?
5093.answer: He is mowing the overgrown lawn.

5094.about: In a busy gym, a very thin young man with red hair pulls up his vest sleeve and flexes his arm with a strained grimace — the arm stays narrow and bony. The clip cuts to a woman in a blue top who flexes a clearly rounded, defined bicep and smiles at the camera, and then to a huge bodybuilder in a black vest who raises both arms into a double biceps pose while two friends behind him shout him on.
5094.question: What is the bodybuilder doing?

5095.about: Filmed on a selfie stick, a young man in glasses and a rust-coloured corduroy shirt leans over a museum display case of old coins, sketching them into a small notebook. He then walks through a picture gallery hung with gold-framed paintings, mouth falling open as he looks around. In the great hall he stops under an enormous mounted skeleton, tips his head right back and stares up at it open-mouthed, holding his notebook up, while a line of schoolchildren files past behind him.

phrases.en: to hang from the glass roof

5095.question: What is the man staring at?
5095.answer: He is staring at a huge skeleton.

5097.about: A young red-haired street performer in a denim jacket covered in enamel badges plays an acoustic guitar on a cobbled street at golden hour. An open guitar case lies on the stones in front of him. A small crowd of passers-by has stopped in a loose semicircle to listen, including a woman holding a toddler. He strums hard, throws his strumming hand up over his head, then leans back into the guitar and sings while the onlookers smile and clap.
5097.question: What is the guitar player doing?
5097.answer: He is playing music in the street.

5098.about: A packed floodlit football stadium at night. A young man in the foreground has his face painted half light blue and half white, the colours of his country, and wears the same light-blue-and-white striped shirt and a matching scarf. He hammers a big drum strapped to his chest while the whole stand around him sings and jumps in the same colours. Scarves are held up overhead, and then a huge light-blue-and-white flag is passed over the crowd until it covers the whole frame; he looks up at it, still shouting.
5098.question: What is the red-haired man looking at?
5098.answer: He is looking at the national flag.
